children: The two nuclear reactors of Romanian state power producer Nuclearelectrica
will likely remain turned off throughout September due to low water levels in the Danube river, a deputy energy minister said.

"It is possible that throughout September we will have a situation in which the flow at the entrance to the country will be low and the water level in the Cernavoda area... will be insufficient to restart the plant," Cristian Busoi was quoted as saying by state news agency Agerpress.
